newsitem.title: JAPAN: JAL, NCA talk with forwarders on cargo rate hikes.
newsitem.headline: JAL, NCA talk with forwarders on cargo rate hikes.

text.p: Japan Airlines Co Ltd (JAL) and Nippon Cargo Airlines Co Ltd (NCA) said on Monday that they were separately negotiating with forwarders over possible increases in air cargo rates from April.
Officials of the two companies said that the rate increases were necessary to cope with higher fuel prices since last year.
A JAL official said JAL was seeking an average increase of 30 to 50 yen per kg of air cargo from Japan. But he added the actual figure would vary among forwarders and types of cargo.
The forwarders with whom JAL is negotiating with include Nippon Express Co Ltd and Kintetsu World Express Inc, a unit of Kinki Nippon Railway Co Ltd, the JAL official said.
NCA, which is unlisted, could not immediately provide the range of planned rate increases and other details.
